create_backend_enum: create a Backend enum to represent array library backends like numpy, cupy, torch, dask, jax, and sparse
get_backend_modname: get the module name from a Backend enum value by stripping the extra tag after the colon
check_backend_like: check if a Backend uses the same underlying module as other Backend values
generate_pytest_param: generate a pytest parameter with skip marks for array_api_strict on numpy <1.26 and thread_unsafe for dask and jax
get_numpy_version: get the installed numpy version as a tuple of three integers from np.__version__
